records.title: Novel behavioral assay of noxious heat responses in Drosophila using decapitated flies

decisions.notes: Short meeting abstract rather than a full methods paper. Tested fly stage and specific pain allele are not stated; no sample size, effect size, test statistic or reproducible protocol is reported. Intact-fly jumping >45 C and decapitated-fly tumbling at 44 C are different conditions. Tumbling is observed motor/nociceptive behavior, not subjective pain; no SCS or ECAP task is present.
